name: The Pile
description: 800GB of diverse text from ArXiv, GitHub, Wikipedia and other sources; used to train large-scale language models.
purpose: General language model pre-training and broad knowledge coverage.

name: Common Crawl
description: Monthly crawls of billions of web pages.
purpose: Up-to-date information and long-form textual content for pre-training and knowledge retrieval.

name: WikiText
description: High-quality Wikipedia articles retaining complex editorial structures and long-range dependencies.
purpose: Structured and well-edited text corpus for language modeling.

name: OpenWebText
description: Corpus created from URLs posted on Reddit; offers diverse online texts similar to the WebText dataset.
purpose: Pre-training and large-scale text generation tasks.

name: LAION-5B
description: 5.85 billion image–text pairs harvested from the web.
purpose: Multimodal training for tasks like text-to-image generation and image understanding.

name: MS COCO
description: Rich image dataset with annotations for object detection, segmentation and captioning.
purpose: Image understanding and caption generation.

name: Open Images
description: Community-driven dataset containing 1.9 million images with labels, bounding boxes and segmentation masks.
purpose: Object detection and visual recognition tasks.

name: RedPajama-1T
description: A trillion-token pre-training dataset compiled from filtered web, books and code sources.
purpose: Pre-training large language models with high-quality diverse text.

name: RedPajama-V2
description: An updated RedPajama dataset containing tokens in 30 languages and multiple modalities.
purpose: Multilingual model pre-training and cross-lingual research.

name: OpenAI WebGPT
description: Human-annotated dataset of web-browsing interactions including queries, clicks and extracted snippets.
purpose: Training agents to search and interact with the web safely and accurately.

name: Obsidian Agent Dataset
description: Synthetic collection of tasks designed to evaluate autonomous decision-making and planning skills.
purpose: Testing and training autonomous agents to decompose complex goals.

name: WebShop
description: E-commerce dataset with product descriptions, user browsing and purchase interaction logs.
purpose: Developing intelligent agents that perform product research and purchasing decisions.

name: Meta EAI Dataset
description: Simulation scenarios for embodied AI focused on virtual and real-world interactions.
purpose: Robotics and household task planning for physical or simulated agents.

name: MuJoCo
description: Physics-engine dataset enabling realistic robotic simulations for control tasks.
purpose: Training reinforcement-learning agents for motor control and robotics.

name: Robotics Datasets
description: Collections of real-world sensor and robot interaction data.
purpose: Training embodied AI systems for tasks like navigation, manipulation and perception.

name: Atari Games
description: Benchmark dataset for reinforcement learning with sequential decision-making challenges.
purpose: Developing and benchmarking RL agents on classic video games.

name: Web-crawled Interactions
description: Large-scale user behaviour data extracted from online platforms.
purpose: Training interactive agents based on user behaviour patterns.

name: AI2 ARC Dataset
description: Multi-choice question dataset for commonsense reasoning and problem-solving tasks.
purpose: Testing and training models on commonsense and reasoning capabilities.

name: MS MARCO
description: Large-scale dataset for passage ranking, question answering and retrieval-augmented generation.
purpose: Developing models for information retrieval and reading comprehension tasks.

name: OpenAI Gym
description: Collection of simulated environments for reinforcement-learning research.
purpose: Benchmarking and training RL agents across varied tasks.

name: Natural Instructions
description: 193k instruction–output examples sourced from 61 English NLP tasks.
purpose: Instruction-tuning to improve the ability of models to follow tasks.

name: Super-Natural Instructions
description: Crowd-sourced collection of 5 million examples across 76 tasks in 55 languages.
purpose: Large-scale instruction data for multilingual instruction tuning.

name: Unnatural Instructions
description: 240k automatically generated instruction examples created by prompting InstructGPT and paraphrasing.
purpose: Diversifying instruction-tuning datasets with automatically generated tasks.

name: Self-Instruct
description: 82k examples generated automatically using InstructGPT conditioned on seed tasks.
purpose: Instruction tuning with synthetic tasks to enhance model performance.

name: P3
description: Prompt collection for 177 English NLP tasks with approximately 11 different prompts per dataset.
purpose: Studying the impact of different prompt formulations on model performance.

name: xP3 and xP3mt
description: Extension of P3 containing 19 multilingual datasets and 11 code datasets; the machine-translated variant xP3mt includes prompts translated into 20 languages.
purpose: Multilingual instruction tuning and prompt engineering research.

name: Flan 2021/Flan 2022
description: Collections of prompt templates for dozens of tasks; Flan 2022 combines Flan 2021, P3, Super-Natural Instructions and additional reasoning and dialogue datasets.
purpose: Instruction tuning with prompts enabling few-shot and zero-shot learning and chain-of-thought reasoning.

name: Opt-IML Bench
description: Dataset combining Super-Natural Instructions, P3 and Flan, with cross-task transfer, knowledge grounding and dialogue datasets.
purpose: Evaluating models on a broad range of instruction-following tasks and chain-of-thought reasoning.

name: Alpaca
description: 52k instruction examples generated via self-instruct using OpenAI’s text-davinci-003.
purpose: Building and fine-tuning instruction-following models at low cost.

name: Evol-Instruct
description: 250k English instruction–response pairs created by rewriting and elaborating on Alpaca data to increase complexity.
purpose: Enhancing instruction datasets by making tasks more complex and specialized.

name: Vicuna ShareGPT
description: 70k multi-turn conversations scraped from ShareGPT with preprocessing to convert HTML to markdown and remove low-quality samples.
purpose: Training conversational agents that handle multi-turn dialogues and maintain context.

name: Baize
description: 54k and 57k multi-turn dialog examples generated using ChatGPT with questions from Quora and StackOverflow datasets.
purpose: Training models on multi-turn human–AI conversation simulation.
